FILM DESCRIPTION: 
On a search for his missing friend Jonathan Harker (John Van Eyssen), vampire hunter Dr. Van Helsing (Peter Cushing) is led to Count Dracula's (Christopher Lee) castle. Upon arriving, Van Helsing finds an undead Harker in Dracula's crypt and discovers that the count's next target is Harker's ailing fiancée, Lucy Holmwood (Carol Marsh). With the help of her brother, Arthur (Michael Gough), Van Helsing struggles to protect Lucy and put an end to Count Dracula's parasitic reign of terror.

recentItems.title: Daisy Edgar-Jones on ‘Sense and Sensibility’ and the Actresses Who Inspire Her
recentItems.description:
Focus Features stars celebrate the women who define the brand and how their own roles continue that legacy in 'Women in Focus Features', a new series co-produced by @FocusFeatures & Rotten Tomatoes!

Daisy Edgar-Jones, star of the new Jane Austen adaptation ‘Sense and Sensibility’, joins Rotten Tomatoes and Focus Features to share her experience bringing her iconic character, Elinor Dashwood, to life!  Edgar-Jones shares how she has always been attracted to women characters who are sensitive and strong-willed.  She describes how Elinor maybe represent “Sense”, but at her heart is filled with sensibility.  And, she shares a list of women in film who inspire her.  See ‘Sense and Sensibility in theaters October 16!
